desc:
"The world has fallen. Protect the Core. Survive the horde."

How to Play:

☀️ DAYTIME 
• Daily Airdrops Incoming! Loot & Build, Before Nightfall!  
• Airdrops may contain:  
  🛡️ Reinforced Walls/Traps  
  🔫 Heavy Turrets  
  💥 Volatile Fuel Canister (Highly explosive! Handle with care!)  

🌙 NIGHTTIME  
• You and your team have one mission:  
  🧟 ELIMINATE ALL ZOMBIES!  
  💎 PROTECT THE CORE AT ALL COSTS!  
  ❤️‍🔥 STAY ALIVE!  

⚠️ WARNING: Extreme weather spawns ENHANCED ZOMBIES!  

**CONTROLS:**  
- LMB/RT - SHOOT  
- RMB/LT - AIM DOWN SIGHTS  
- LShift/Y - SPRINT  
- R/X - RELOAD  
- F/B - DISARM TRAPS  
- ~ - OPEN BACKPACK  

Work together... or die alone!
